title: Whitney extension theorem for C¹ jets (Simon 2.1.6)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, closed A ⊆ ℝⁿ, h : ℝⁿ → ℝ continuous on A and ν : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ continuous on A such that for every compact K ⊆ A and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with |h(y) − h(x) − ⟨ν(x), y − x⟩| ≤ ε|y − x| for all x ∈ K and y ∈ A with 0 < |y − x| < δ, there is a C¹ function g : ℝⁿ → ℝ with g(x) = h(x) and Dg(x)v = ⟨ν(x), v⟩ for all x ∈ A and v ∈ ℝⁿ.
